# Principal Electro-Mechanical Manufacturing Engineer — K2 Space

---

**Job ID:** Not listed (Greenhouse posting id `5228104008`)
**Date Posted:** Not listed
**Date Applied:** Aug 1, 2026
**Salary Range:** $175,000 – $200,000 + equity

---

## Job Summary

K2 Space is a Series C satellite manufacturer ($450M raised, $500M in signed contracts) building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown. The role owns manufacturability, first-prototype builds, build-flow/fixturing design, and the transition to production for large spacecraft structures, mechanisms, and integrated electronics. Onsite at K2's Torrance, CA headquarters (posting lists Los Angeles, CA).

---

## What You'll Do

- Own end-to-end manufacturing strategy for subsystems from concept through production ramp.
- Lead DFM efforts with design engineering, architecting scalable production flows for electromechanical systems, harnessing, and mechanisms.
- Develop/deploy advanced manufacturing technologies, automation, and tooling; establish production-readiness plans (control plans, work instructions, takt alignment, line balancing).
- Mentor junior engineers/technicians; lead first article builds and flight-hardware integration; develop capacity models and drive continuous improvement.

### Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in electrical, mechanical, aerospace, or related engineering
- 10+ years in a high-volume, rapid-production manufacturing/integration/design role
- Demonstrated product development/process-improvement results; first-article-build leadership; production-line scale-up; cross-functional influence for manufacturability

Nice to have: tooling design for subassemblies/electronics, team leadership, aerospace mfg standards (IPC, torque/welding, AS9100), CAD (NX or equivalent) + GD&T, MES experience.

### Education
Bachelor's degree in electrical, mechanical, aerospace, or other relevant engineering discipline.

### Benefits
Equity in the company; unlimited PTO; medical/dental/vision coverage; life insurance; paid parental leave.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Aug 1, 2026

- **Strong overlap:** BS in Electro-Mechanical Engineering matches directly; extensive first-article-through-production experience (ICARUS-Lite from development through commercialization plus ~5 new hires added; POSEIDON generations; THE KRAKEN full lifecycle from CAD/BOM through fabrication, assembly, and firmware tuning). Fixture and tooling design is an explicit skill, as is Siemens NX (a literal match for the "CAD software NX or equivalent" nice-to-have). Team leadership and mentoring (oversight of the East Coast engineering team) also line up.
- **Notable gap at this date:** the skills list live on the site at the time of this application did **not** yet explicitly itemize Design for Assembly (DFA), GD&T, Lean Manufacturing, or Lean Six Sigma as named skills — even though the Lean Six Sigma White and Yellow Belt certifications were already earned (Jun/Jul 2025). The site under-represented exactly the keywords this posting emphasizes (DFM/DFA, GD&T).
- **Gap:** 10+ years required vs. ~5 years of professional experience at the time; no explicit aerospace/AS9100 or MES experience.

### Now — Aug 22, 2026

- The skills list was updated Aug 8, 2026 to explicitly add **Design for Assembly (DFA)**, **Geometric Dimensioning & Toleranceing (GD&T)**, **Lean Manufacturing**, and **Lean Six Sigma** — closing the keyword gap noted above. The underlying qualifications didn't change; the site simply now states them.
- The years-of-experience and aerospace/AS9100/MES gaps from the application-time snapshot are unchanged.

## About the Company

K2 Space builds high-power satellite platforms for missions from LEO to deep space, positioning itself for an era of "mass abundance" enabled by heavy-lift launch vehicles. Backed by Altimeter Capital, Redpoint Ventures, T. Rowe Price, Lightspeed, and others, with multiple launches planned through 2026–2027.
